definitions.gloss: highlight, masterpiece, most impressive part, showstopper
definitions.explanation: The most outstanding or impressive part of a performance, work, or event. Often used as a predicate: ～は{圧巻|あっかん}だ.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラスト→ラスト：30487_rasuto⟧⟦シーン→シーン：08914_shiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{圧巻|あっかん}だった。
examples.english: The final scene was the highlight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花火|はなび}{大会|たいかい}→花火大会：10105_hanabitaikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧フィナーレ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{圧巻|あっかん}だった。
examples.english: The finale of the fireworks festival was a showstopper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{圧巻|あっかん}だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧{本|ぼん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鳥居|とりい}→鳥居：05956_torii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧だ。
examples.english: What was most impressive above all was the sight of a thousand torii gates lined up in a row.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Originally from the Chinese civil service examination system — the {巻|かん} (scroll/paper) that was placed on top ({圧|あつ}) as the best answer. Hence "the best part."

USAGE:
Most commonly used as a predicate: ～⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{圧巻|あっかん}だ (~ was the highlight). Also used as a modifier: {圧巻|あっかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～ (the stunning ~). Always positive — never used for negative impressions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {圧巻|あっかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧: a stunning performance
- {圧巻|あっかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧: a breathtaking view
- ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{圧巻|あっかん}: most impressive of all
